notes.title: Tri Survive Launch Update: Endless Mode Fixes on the Way!
notes.content:
[p]Greetings Survivors!

Tri Survive is finally out! Our very first game release, a huge milestone for us at Majestic Mind Games. But as much as we’d love to take a moment to celebrate, we’re already hard at work on the next updates.

One of the first things on our radar is the Endless Mode, those of you who have completed all levels and started testing your true survivability skills in the Endless Mode may have noticed some issues we want to address right away:[/p][p][/p][p]- Performance drops, If you survive for long enough, the enemy hordes get too crazy, making things choppy if you’re not clearing them fast enough.[/p][p]- Level cap stuck at 50, after this point, no more stat bonuses (attack speed, damage, etc) are applied to the heroes. And no more special cards appear on leveling up (Heal, Triangle Ability Re-charge, Riches).[/p][p]-  EXP/Gold overflow, past level 51, orbs and gold pile up under your heroes and don't actually get collected.[/p][p][/p][p]We want you to know we’re on top of this. We’re working on improving the Endless Mode design, optimizing performance during those hectic late game runs, and raising the level cap so you can keep pushing your limits!
[/p][p]Our goal is to have the first patch out next week.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all so much for jumping in, sharing your feedback, and being part of this launch journey with us. And we look forward to enhancing and refining Tri Survive with you.
[/p][p] Stay strong, and tri to survive! ♥[/p][p][/p][p]– The MMG Team[/p]

notes.title: Devlog #6: Hero Lore – Ranya, Arrow of Truth
notes.content:
Greetings, Survivors!

Today, we're diving into the story behind one of our ranged DPS that will join our party of heroes: Ranya Alderlynx, Arrow of Truth. The Archer, in contrast to Alric, comes from a humble background but still manages to prove her worth and be part of the group tasked to save the kingdom. No personal status or wealth matters when it comes to being a hero.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098699/434c66c5b40d9f9d4d73cef0a48256a0913e9b2f.png[/img]

[h2]From Stable Maid to Silent Sentinel, the origins of Ranya[/h2]
Ranya was born lowborn, raised in the shadows of the Kingdom’s castle walls. From a young age, her life was about survival and making sure that the whole family could make it through each day. She took on any work she could find to support her household, eventually landing a job as a stable maid within the palace grounds.
Ranya’s excellent work as a maid caught the eye of Lightkeeper Elaria, a noblewoman of immense grace and quiet influence. Elaria offered Ranya a position as her handmaiden. For the first time, Ranya found stability. But peace, as it turned out, was not her destiny. The soon-to-be archer felt uneasy with her newfound quietness, as if she was “stuck in paradise” rather than enjoying it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098699/c618441fcea522373308e309a4186c93a58ab387.png[/img]

[h2]The Spark: A Bow, A Chance[/h2]
It was during her time at Elaria’s side that Ranya first witnessed the Royal Rangers in action, a rare and revered group of warriors who scouted the kingdom’s borderlands in secrecy. Agile, cunning, and masters of the bow. They struck a chord in her spirit.
Fate intervened on a mission escorting Elaria when an injured Ranger was brought in for recovery. Ranya tended to him and, at his suggestion, tried her hand at archery. The results were unexpected: Ranya was a natural. A hidden talent awakened, and with it, a longing she could no longer ignore. Maybe it was time to let go of her paradise.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098699/7b0f85faf41136742c9ce618c8a7e4a07d5d2bc3.png[/img]

[h2]Leaving the Paradise Behind[/h2]
After wrestling with uncertainty, Ranya finally asked Elaria for permission to leave her service and join the Rangers. Though saddened, Elaria honored the request, but the noble was secretly disappointed in losing her handmaiden to the Whispering Woods. Perhaps she thought the gruelling life of a Ranger would send Ranya back. But instead, it shaped her.
Ranya proved herself. She not only survived the harsh world of the Rangers, but she thrived in it. Her precision, intelligence, and resolve earned her the name "Arrow of Truth."


[h2]Who are the Rangers? [/h2]
The Royal Rangers are a secretive unit within the royal army. Few in number, they operate in the shadows, unseen ninja-like agents. Each one is trained to be self-sufficient, lethal, and loyal to the kingdom above all else.
Ranya stands out even among them, not only for her skill but for the nobility of her choices.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098699/88793af21c309af8a5572c05d60e00fd8db64418.png[/img]

[h2]In-Game Role[/h2]
Ranya is one of the ranged DPS who uses her mobility to create an advantage to blast the enemies with her high burst damage. Her background within the Dark Rangers shapes her skills, making her strategic positioning and agility one of her main strengths on the battlefield. The demons will have a run for their money trying to hit her.

The archer is smart, cunning, and bold enough to speak her mind when it matters the most. She’s not afraid to openly state her opinion with the other party members, no matter if they’re revered mages or the son of a king.


We can’t wait for you to experience Ranya's journey! She’s not just another archer, she’s a symbol of choice, conviction, and the courage to change your fate. All these qualities earned her a spot in the heroes’ group tasked to save the Kingdom!
Follow us on socials and join the discussion on our Discord Server to be updated with the latest Tri Survive news!

notes.title: Devlog #5 – Introducing the New Demo: Expanded Content & Major Upgrades
notes.content:
Hey Survivors!

We’re thrilled to share that this devlog is centered around the upcoming Tri Survive demo, releasing on May 16th, and what you can expect when you dive into it. A lot has changed since the last build we shared during the Alpha playtest we did back in January, and we can’t wait to hear what you think!
You can download the demo [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3698210/Tri_Survive_Demo/]here[/url].

Before getting started, we remind you that this demo will be open to anyone. This means that anyone interested can navigate to the Tri Survive Demo page, download the demo, and start playing it instantly (on May 16th).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098699/fc5f67d267e18952c877b0cd1f2c48943de61ae1.png[/img]

[h2]What's in the Demo?[/h2]
Players will start with the base 3 heroes:

- Alric, Commander of the Vanguard (tank), 
- Elaria, Light Keeper of the Crown (healer),
- Ignis, Archmage of the Eternal Flame (DPS),

Each has distinct abilities tied to their roles and synergizes in combat. 

And you can get familiar with the gameplay with the starting characters through the first 2 levels:

- Castle Courtyard.
- Rocky Desert.

The Castle Courtyard is where the story begins and is considered the tutorial level. Reading some quick dialogue between the characters before you begin the fight sets up the story and the background for the game, as well as some dialogue with the first boss you encounter. And upon completing that level, you will unlock the Rocky Desert, where you continue your journey in battling the demonic invasion that has plagued the lands and unraveling the mystery of why and where those demons are coming from.

Completing the 2nd level will unlock your first new hero, “Granite, Heart of the Earth” (tank). This big, beefy boy packs quite a punch! So it will be fun to experience a new character with his own set of attacks and abilities, and you can choose to replay the first 2 levels again with the new dynamic that he brings to the team.

You can also experience the [b]Tri Ultimate Ability[/b]: a powerful attack that is performed by all 3 heroes at once and you can manually trigger it (by pressing F) once it is charged-up during combat and offers devastating power that can get you out of a tough situation, help you finish off the boss or mow down that army of demos that piled up and been chasing you for the past 3 minutes.

Lastly, you will also try out the [b]Power Up Shop[/b], the meta progression system in the game, and where the “rogue-lite” aspect comes in. Here you can purchase upgrades that affect your party's health, damage, speed, and ability cooldowns. In the future, the power-up shop will expand to include upgrades to the individual tank, healer, and DPS roles themselves, regardless of which combination of these heroes you choose in your party.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098699/d875a488df4d6d0959b182951312df1b2faca8fb.png[/img]

[h2]Improvements Since the Last Playtest[/h2]
We’ve been hard at work polishing the experience based on your feedback. Here’s what’s new:

[list]
[*] [b]All in-game art has been updated,[/b] including character designs, animations, and interface elements.
[*] [b]Enemy wave balancing[/b] has been significantly refined to improve difficulty curves and flow.
[*] [b]Hero Abilities [/b]balancing and tweaking, your squad will feel more powerful and intentional with their abilities.
[*] [b]UI/UX and VFX improvements[/b] for a smoother experience, and a bit better readability, some of the heroes got improvements to their attack visuals as well. 
[*] [b]A Classic Experience-Based leveling system[/b], where previously you would level up immediately upon picking up “Ability Orbs”, we replaced those with “Experience Obs”, which you collect from slain enemies to fill up your experience bar and then choose an ability upgrade each time you level up.
[*] [b]Audio and Music![/b] We added some cool new sound effects to the heroes' abilities as well as some of the enemies and bosses, where previously it was all lame placeholder sounds. And added a new background music track that is still a work in progress.
[*] [b]Improved Interactive Tutorial[/b], previously we had a bunch of text that you had to read at the start of the level that explained the controls and gameplay, and now it is more integrated within the gameplay, as you get messages periodically that explain the controls.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098699/704fbd2066dbc1fff2ccd400c5a0161078b59325.png[/img]

[h2]Your Feedback[/h2]
As you explore the demo, we’d love your input on what you have experienced and the elements that you found good to play around with, and others that did not convince you fully. Specifically, we want to know more about these main features:
Tri-control mechanic

[list]
[b][*] Story pacing
[*] Abilities & upgrades
[*] UI clarity
[*] Bugs & performance[/b]
[/list]

Join our [url=https://discord.gg/WAmT9SMBmG]Discord Server[/url] to chat with the rest of the community and follow us on our socials to be the first to know about the latest news for Tri Survive!

notes.title: Devlog #4 – Spotlight on Alric, Commander of the Vanguard
notes.content:
Greetings Survivors!

In our last devlog, we explained the reasons behind the change in Tri Survive’s art direction and the significance of this shift for both gameplay and the story. Today, we are excited to share new information about one of the main characters you will control during your adventure!

The spotlight is all on Alric, brave Commander of the Vanguard and one of the core heroes of Tri Survive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098699/74ded53391c01eb4042ad9bae01372856eeeea44.png[/img]

[h2]Who is Alric? An introduction to the Commander of the Vanguard[/h2]
Alric's backstory and motives are strictly tied to the narrative of Tri Survive. His values, his grief, and his will to unite the fractured kingdoms are some of the pivotal points of the story.

Alric is the elder son of the fallen king. During the demon invasion, he stepped into his father's role at a time when the royal guard was in disarray. Alric courageously led them into battle against their fierce enemy to protect their land.

Beneath his heavy armor, the proud prince carries the weight of personal loss and uncertainty. Not only must he cope with his father’s death, but he is also tormented by the mysterious disappearance of his younger brother, Prince Lucien. Alric is not just fighting for his kingdom, he is also seeking the truth about what happened to his family.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098699/39874d06d3e5b1ee88c2c39898dfb1ae2dd535ac.png[/img]

[h2]What changed in Alric’s visuals[/h2]
During Tri Survive’s art rework, Alric's model underwent a rehaul to better display his character and to provide better clarity even during gameplay.

Now the paladin’s armor appears to be bulkier and with sharper, better-defined features that highlight his figure better on the battlefield. The development team also applied several adjustments to Alric’s anatomy and armor details, most notably his helm. The changes had the goal of making the paladin stand out and emanate the royal and proud aura that distinguishes his character from the rest of the party. One of the most defining features of Alric is his bravery and leadership, and we had to make sure that every player could see that just by taking a glance at the royal son.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098699/257e997b64f49c89748a11bbcf2454811c12c163.png[/img]

[h2]Alric’s gameplay explained[/h2]
Expect a frontline aggro-machine ready to take all the big hits for your party and hold the enemies while the DPS decimate the horde of demons coming at you.

Alric’s arsenal is straightforward to learn: his Divine Whirlwind draws enemy aggro, and his immunities and defensives let him easily survive oncoming attacks. The paladin's strength lies in his ability to hold chokepoints and control potential flanks,by using cleave skills and explosion chains abilities to control the incoming horde of enemies.

Compared to the other playable tanks in Tri Survive, Alric’s gameplay is not based around stuns or slow effects. He is all about leading the charge and holding the frontline, while you can use your DPS abilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098699/23ebcb0bb0ac5013b392a3ac0e7862ebf9897e8e.gif[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #3 - Tri Survive Art Design Revamped!
notes.content:
Hey Survivors! 
We have a big announcement to share with you all.
Today, we officially announce the revamp of Tri Survive's main characters’ art style! We've decided to give our characters a new look to make them feel more alive, defined, and integrated into the style we want for the final version of Tri Survive! We would love to hear your thoughts on this, so please let us know if you have any feedback on our socials or Discord community!


[h2]Why We Reworked the Art?[/h2]
After a long evaluation, the development team realized that the previous art design did not reflect Tri Survive's overall mood. Besides the aesthetic factor, we also noticed that during our testing phase, the previous silhouettes and sprites weren’t visible, especially during sections where many enemies were on screen, thus making gameplay more frustrating.


We believe that the new style gives all the main characters a different kind of aura and makes them feel more like “heroes” than before. Now, the designs offer more vibrant colors, better anatomic proportions, and richer details for the protagonists’ armor.

So, how can we describe the revamped Tri Survive Art Design?

The development team took inspiration from video games that are also known for their unique art style, such as League of Legends and Unicorn Overlord. The main influence is the high-fantasy look, which allowed the team to create silhouettes with sharper lines that allow us to develop characters with more personality. Something that our past approach could not replicate as well as now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098699/625dfbe385c02d3fed3f493fcac308e069c62347.gif[/img]

notes.title: Tri Survive - Devlog #2: The Alpha Build is Here!
notes.content:
Hey Survivors!

We have some big news to share—the Alpha build is complete! We’ve made huge progress since our last update, and this milestone brings us closer to completing Tri Survive’s development. We have added several core features to offer multiple opportunities to enrich your gameplay possibilities and customization.

Below, you can find more details on the main work we have added in Tri Survive Alpha Build.

[h2]A New Battlefield: Rocky Highlands[/h2]
Introducing Rocky Highlands, a treacherous new map filled with rugged rocky terrain. Brace yourself for new enemies, unpredictable hazards, and intense battles that will test your survival skills like never before!


The introduction of Rocky Highlands marks key progress for Tri Survive by offering a diversified map pool that not only diversifies the type of environment you will find during your adventures but also introduces you to new enemies, ambient hazards, and obstacles that will test your combat skills and coordination while controlling your party.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098699/6d9fa8254c3d9ee6b127777ce2f59a20dc7a5334.png[/img]

[h2]Power-Up Shop: Strengthen Your Heroes[/h2]
We’ve added a Power-Up Shop, giving you a way to enhance your heroes mid-run. Spend resources to unlock upgrades, boost stats, and modify your playstyle for each session. Strategy matters—choose wisely!

The Power-Up Shop’s purpose is to customize your gameplay even further by letting you decide, based on your current needs, which are the best upgrades for your party! This means you can choose the most fitting playstyle based on your current situation: do you need more survivability, AoE damage, or movement speed to counter your enemies' attacks? The Power-Up Shop will be your best friend and help you out in your journey to save the world!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098699/d732303d3de9cd8029e61b35d5fca02bfbb1f812.png[/img]

[h2]
What’s Next?[/h2]
With most of the core game systems almost completed, our focus is currently on gameplay balance, expanding and improving the overall player experience, character art and visuals, polishing the UI, and preparing for the next phases with beta testing and a public demo soon!

notes.title: Tri Survive - Dev Log #1: Welcome to the Journey!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

Welcome to the very first development log for Tri Survive! We’re excited to finally start sharing more about our game with you, as we’ve been hard at work bringing our vision to life. Whether you're into roguelites or RPGs, we hope you'll find something to love in Tri Survive, so let’s dive into what makes our game unique and where we are in the development process.


[b]What is Tri Survive?[/b]

For those of you just hearing about Tri Survive, it's a single-player 2D action roguelite with RPG elements, set in a hand-drawn fantasy world. But here’s the twist – instead of controlling just one hero, you’ll take charge of three heroes simultaneously! Each hero brings their own skills, powers, and personalities, and it’s up to you to master the synergy between them to survive the game's many challenges.

We’re striving for a balance between engaging strategic gameplay and fast-paced action. With two game modes – Storyline Mode and Survival Mode – and plenty of content to unlock, Tri Survive will offer hours of replayability.


[b]The Heroes[/b]

At the start, you’ll have access to three unique heroes. But as you progress through Storyline Mode, you’ll be able to unlock more heroes. Each hero fits into a different role – whether it's an agile healer, a powerful mage, or a sturdy tank. The challenge is figuring out how to combine their abilities to defeat the increasingly difficult enemies you’ll face.

One thing we’re particularly proud of is that each hero feels distinct, both in terms of combat style and personality. Our artists and animators are pouring tons of creativity into making them stand out visually too!


[b]Game Modes[/b]

We wanted to give players more than just the typical survival roguelite experience. That’s why we created two different modes:

[list]
[*] [b]Storyline Mode[/b]: Play through a fantasy adventure where you unlock new heroes and explore different regions. This mode gives players a structured path to progress and discover more about the world of Tri Survive.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098699/6beff8e0d0b71ac0f6babfd5377959de0b8f51de.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Survival Mode[/b]: For those who love the roguelite challenge, this is where you’ll be tested. You'll fight wave after wave of increasingly difficult enemies, with only the heroes you’ve unlocked. How long can you survive?
[/list]


[b]Our Progress So Far[/b]

Development has been moving steadily, and we’re happy to report that we’re on track for our Q2 of 2025 launch! Be sure to wish list the game on Steam here so that you are notified when we launch!

Right now, we’re focused on refining the enemy waves system, finalizing the animations for the first batch of heroes, and designing the maps that will be featured in the game. Our team is working tirelessly to make sure everything looks and feels perfect.


[b]What's Next?[/b]

In the coming weeks, we’ll be sharing more about the heroes, game mechanics, and our development progress, as we make our way towards releasing a Demo in Q1 of 2025!

So be sure to join our Discord server, where you can chat with us directly, give feedback, participate in our Alpha and Beta testing, and have your feedback and ideas included in the demo and the final game.


To Participate in our Alpha and Beta testing:
[b][url=https://discord.gg/PaUxnbwXQm]Join Discord[/url][/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3072970/Tri_Survive/

Thank you all for your support so far – we’re beyond excited to keep you updated on this journey. Stay tuned for our next devlog, where we’ll take a deep dive into the game’s combat system and showcase some of our favorite heroes!

Until next time, happy surviving! 

– The Majestic Mind Games Team
